blocks.text: "I believe that the code for Lebanon is 961," the shopkeeper said.
blocks.note: قالت صاحبة المحل: "أعتقد أن كود لبنان هو 961".

blocks.text: "But don't you think that it's a little big?" asked the shopkeeper.
blocks.note: سألت صاحبة المحل: "ولكن، ألا تظنها كبيرة قليلًا؟".

blocks.text: "No," the shopkeeper replied. "I'm quite serious. You saw the price tag."
blocks.note: ردت صاحبة المحل: "لا، أنا جادة. رأيتَ السعر".

blocks.text: "Well?" the impatient shopkeeper asked, once Dima had ended the call. "Is everything all set now?"
